description: The one-person studio. Brand, web, and product work for founders who want one accountable human instead of a slide deck of departments.
Led a four-person team through a full replatform and rebrand. Learned that shipping beats presenting, and wrote the design system that outlived my tenure.
Design systems and growth work for a developer-tools startup. Discovered that engineers are the best design critics you'll ever get for free.
Brand and web for cultural clients — galleries, festivals, one opera house. Where I learned that budgets are creative constraints wearing a disguise.
Underpriced everything, overdelivered everything, slept rarely. Kept the lessons, dropped the invoicing spreadsheet.
